theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_vloc_fraction_characterization
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] (V : ValuationSubring E) (q : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E)), q.IsPrime → q ≠ ⊥ → (∀ a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, (a : E) ∈ V) → (∀ a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, (a : E) ∈ V.nonunits ↔ a ∈ q) → ∀ x : E, x ∈ V ↔ ∃ a b : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, b ∉ q ∧ x = (a : E) / (b : E)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
